grid.title: Resumo de Vendas por Vendedor
grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS PARCEIRO, CAB.VLRNOTA + NVL(CAB.VLROUTROS,0) + NVL(AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0) AS VALORTOTAL, (CASE WHEN CAB.CODEMP = 1 THEN '#B2FFFF' ELSE '#DFD2C4' END) AS BKCOLOR FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR CAB.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) ORDER BY CAB.NUMNOTA

chart.expression: SELECT CAB.CODVEND || ' - ' || VEN.APELIDO AS VENDEDOR, sum(CAB.VLRNOTA + NVL(CAB.VLROUTROS,0) + NVL(AD_VLROUTROSFRETE,0)) AS VALORTOTAL FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON CAB.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR CAB.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) GROUP BY CAB.CODVEND || ' - ' || VEN.APELIDO
